message: `?` on an optional value needs a function that returns an optional, but `nick` returns `Str`

notes.message: use `??` to supply a default, `if let`, or `match` (core 2.5)

`x?.f` is optional chaining in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Swift; Xo's postfix `?` instead returns early from the function. To keep the value optional, write `x.map(fn(v) { v.f })`, then `?? default` (spec/std.md 2)
